A Commission from one of my supporter!

Sometime during the night, an evil convoy is approaching a peaceful village. Not knowing that inside the cart are the infected girls that were ambushed and have their bodies corrupted... They stop at an tavern in the middle of the village.

With their weapons drawn, they starts attacking everybody inside... Shocked by the infected appearance, most of them were killed. One person resisted but she quickly falls as well, because of the attack the building caught on fire. There are some survivors, the infected girls let them live only to use their bodies for pleasure and lust...
